visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and a black-and-white checkered shirt stands on a sunny urban sidewalk. He gestures with his hands while talking, a black bag slung over his shoulder. Behind him is a tree-lined street with passing scooters and a modern glass-fronted building with a sign that reads 'THEINFINITE HAIR SALON'. (2) Inside a brightly lit studio hair salon, the man is seated in a styling chair draped in a white cape. A stylist wearing a black mask and white shirt uses an electric clipper to trim the man's sideburns. The man holds a white smartphone to record himself in the mirror, winking and smiling. (3) The man lies back in a white ceramic hair-washing station. The stylist, still in a white shirt and mask, uses a showerhead to rinse his hair. Bubbles and foam are visible as the man's eyes are closed and he smiles. (4) Back in the styling chair, the man has a white towel wrapped around his head. The stylist uses a black hair dryer to style the man's now shorter hair. The background shows professional hair products from 'SHISEIDO PROFESSIONAL'. (5) The man stands in the salon, showing off his new haircut. He wears the same checkered shirt and gestures excitedly. On-screen text overlays show details of the hair salon location and price.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over a bright, upbeat electronic pop track. The voice is fast-paced with high arousal. Background urban traffic hum is faint. (2) A mechanical buzz of electric clippers cuts in, layered with the ongoing narration and BGM. The speaker's tone remains cheerful and informative. (3) Sound of splashing water and gentle liquid movement during the hair wash phase. The BGM ducks slightly to let the 'wash' sound artifacts through. The speaker makes satisfied, relaxed vocalizations. (4) Loud whoosh of a high-velocity hair dryer dominates the mid-frequencies while the speaker continues to describe the styling process. BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) Final narration block with a 'ding' UI sound effect. The music swells slightly as the speaker asks a closing question, ending with high-pitched positive intonation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a spontaneous and affordable haircut experience at a salon in Bangkok. It aims to share the novelty of the situation, the quality of Thai styling services for tourists, and provide a recommendation based on value-for-money.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While the salon name is clearly visible and praised, the tone is a personal recommendation of a spontaneous travel experience rather than a paid partnership.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social media editing with constant subtitles and variety-show style text overlays. The use of BGM and SFX creates a highly engaging, fast-paced consumer vlog.
